create_ConfusionMatrix_from_detections: create a ConfusionMatrix from predicted and ground-truth Detections objects with configurable confidence and IoU thresholds
build_ConfusionMatrix_benchmark: build a ConfusionMatrix by running a model callback over a DetectionDataset and evaluating predictions
plot_ConfusionMatrix: plot a ConfusionMatrix visualization with optional normalization, custom classes, and save to file
create_MeanAveragePrecision_from_detecti: create MeanAveragePrecision metrics (mAP50, mAP75, mAP50-95) from predicted and ground-truth Detections objects
run_MeanAveragePrecision_benchmark: run MeanAveragePrecision benchmark by evaluating a model callback over a DetectionDataset
